item.description:
Release v5.4.0

Changes since v5.3.0

  • docs(LumiFactory): update SettingsTab documentation
  • feat: implement conversation store pagination and loading states
  • feat(ActivityHeatmapPlugin): add about view and token chart
  • feat(AgentTurnRunnerPlugin): add daily count chart and lazy loading
  • feat(AppIconDesignerPlugin): add about view
  • feat(AppUpdatePlugin): remove AboutSettingsView
  • feat(BrewManagerPlugin): add about view
  • feat(CADDesignerPlugin): add about view
  • feat(ConversationPendingMessagePlugin): add pending message management
  • feat(ConversationStorePlugin): add daily count chart and lazy loading
  • feat(DiskManagerPlugin): add about view
  • feat(IdleTimePlugin): add about view
  • feat(LLMProviderManagerPlugin): update provider settings pages
  • feat(LumiFactory): add ConversationPendingMessagePlugin dependency
  • feat(LumiKernel): add fileAttachments to LumiPendingMessage
  • feat(LumiKernel): add pending message management to MessageSending
  • feat(LumiKernel): add synchronizeProjects method to ProjectProviding
  • feat(LumiUI): add AppLineChart component and update AppSettingsContentScaffold
  • feat(NetworkManagerPlugin): add daily count chart and lazy loading
  • feat(ProjectRAGPlugin): update settings view
